threads.body: im not sure why we are getting multiple `url.query`s with both STRING and VALUE types... when I run this locally im only getting the `STRING` entry. will keep digging
threads.hunk:
@@ -79,6 +79,8 @@ libraries:
           type: STRING
         - name: url.query
           type: STRING
+        - name: url.query
+          type: VALUE

replies.body: I think that it probably only started with the merging of the #16113 Probably `url.query` is sometimes empty and gets converted to empty value where it previously was omitted.

If that is the case then maybe we should add `&& !"".equals(value)` to https://github.com/open-telemetry/opentelemetry-java-instrumentation/blob/9161d2a6fab92a3a781cf2702b252430e3509fd1/instrumentation-api/src/main/java/io/opentelemetry/instrumentation/api/internal/AttributesExtractorUtil.java#L24
cc @trask

It may be a side-effect of https://github.com/open-telemetry/opentelemetry-java-instrumentation/pull/16113, but it may also be due to underlying SDK bug that hasn't been released yet: https://github.com/open-telemetry/opentelemetry-java/pull/8014

I suspect that the correct fix is probably something along these lines: https://github.com/open-telemetry/opentelemetry-java-instrumentation/pull/16113#discussion_r2777841893 (updating instrumentation not to emit empty strings)
oh, added wrinkle, empty string for `url.query` is actually meaningful, e.g. in `https://example.org/test?`

i've created https://github.com/open-telemetry/opentelemetry-java-instrumentation/issues/16242 to track a resolution for this in case we want to merge this as-is and followup with figuring out how to handle this (or seeing if the updated SDK makes any difference)
